---
name: Feature Request
description: Propose a new feature that enhances Verity's core principles
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Feature Summary
What feature are you proposing and what real-world problem does it solve?

## Use Case
Describe a concrete scenario where this feature would be valuable (not hypothetical).

## Philosophy Alignment
How does this feature align with Verity's principles?
- Does it preserve server-truth authority?
- Does it maintain truth/view-state separation?
- Could this be solved in the view layer instead?
- Is it framework-agnostic?

## Proposed API/Implementation
High-level design or API sketch. Reference existing patterns in Verity.

## Alternatives Considered
What other approaches were considered? Why is this the best fit?

## Breaking Changes
Would this introduce breaking changes? If so, migration plan?
